statements.impact_statement: Alpine 3.24 ships the fix in musl 1.2.6-r3. Scout applies the 1.2.6-r6 fix from Alpine edge.
nestjs-zod and html-to-text only merge OpenAPI schemas and options the server builds itself. No request data reaches deepmerge.

Node.js does not load the system OpenSSL. Only curl, for the plain-HTTP health check on 127.0.0.1, and apk, which never runs in the container, link it. curl is built without HTTP/3, and neither uses QUIC, CMS or AES-GCM-SIV. Alpine 3.24 has no fixed build yet; Scout reads the 3.5.9-r1 fix from Alpine edge.
